components.name: Primary planner button
components.description: Use for the main action in a planner screen or dialog.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #23221b); border-radius: 999px; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink, #23221b); font: 600 13px var(--font-body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; background: var(--hot, #b93825); color: white; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cc7451; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary planner button
components.description: Use for an alternate action alongside the main action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #23221b); border-radius: 999px; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink, #23221b); font: 600 13px var(--font-body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; background: var(--paper, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #23221b); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cc7451; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Planner text field
components.description: A visible label and a paper input with an ink boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Plan name<input class="ds-field" placeholder="Coffee on Saturday"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; color: var(--ink, #23221b); font: 600 12px var(--font-body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-field { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 7px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #23221b); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #23221b); font: 400 13px var(--font-body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #665e50; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cc7451; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-field { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.description: Underline the active page and keep the links on the same baseline.
components.html: My plansMy people
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink, #23221b); text-decoration: none; font: 400 13px/1.2 var(--font-body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--hot, #b93825); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 7px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cc7451; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.northStar: An illustrated invitation with clear planning controls.
narrative.overview:
Us & About pairs the warmth of a paper invitation with the clarity people need to settle a date, check a venue, or reply. Cream backgrounds and ink outlines hold together the cut-paper illustration, red actions, and violet lettering. Keep the illustrations at moments where people imagine or share a plan. Let fields, dates, and response states carry the planning screens.

The web brand combines the illustrated calendar and map pin with the lowercase **us & about** wordmark. The custom violet ampersand belongs to the wordmark. Use the accessible name **Us & About** when the wordmark appears on its own and **Us & About home** when it links home. The native app uses the same calendar illustration as its app icon.
dos: Give each screen a clear heading and one main action. Add a section label when it identifies a task, a collection, or a real step.
Use the illustrated brand where it helps people picture an outing. Give forms and guest lists room to breathe.
Check a narrow phone width and keyboard focus when changing a shared component. Verify that long guest names, titles, and locations can wrap.
donts: Avoid the look of a generic corporate events directory or nightlife-only feed. Show a range of outings and use the existing palette throughout.
Avoid gender stereotypes in illustrations, categories, and suggestions. Use the interests and context people choose for themselves.
